I found nothing real for toddler underwater basket weaving in Halton Hills. The only "underwater basket weaving" classes that came up were adult or college workshops elsewhere, and I didn't count those. 
The UC San Diego one, for example, is for ages 16 and up.
 The Town of Halton Hills recreation pages I read list no such class.

The closest real things I saw on the town's own pages are water-based toddler programs. I left them out of the picks because they are not what was asked for:
- 
The town's Parent and Tot swim levels are 4 to 12 months, 12 to 24 months, and 2 to 3 years.

- 
A parent-and-child drop-in swim runs Tuesday or Thursday, 10:00 to 10:30 a.m., from September 22 to December 29, 2026.
 
It costs $9.58 per class.
 This is the town's own page, and I haven't confirmed it is the same program as the Parent and Tot levels.

I can run a proper search for the toddler swim or another toddler activity if that would help.
